The truth nobody tells you

A real employer pays to hire you. It doesn’t sell you the job.

No agent can guarantee a visa, because governments decide visas, not agents. Your savings and your family’s savings can be gone in one transfer.

Fake job offers hit people in Africa, the Middle East, Singapore, the Philippines and India every day. Different countries. Same script.

How we verify

We don’t say “verified” lightly.

Here is what we check before we call an offer real. If we can’t verify it, we won’t call it real. We’ll say so.

01

The employer exists.

We look it up in the official company register of its country.

02

The contract is real.

Employer name, address, salary, hours and duties, in writing, before you pay anyone.

03

The permit route is legal.

The job and your situation fit a work permit route the country actually offers.

04

The money trail is clean.

We check who is asking you for money, how much, when and where it goes.

Before launch: confirm these four steps match your team’s actual verification process.
